canonical_project: Former IBM Site Spango Valley data centre and BESS (Greenock)

location.country: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

notes: Slate Island Developments is preparing a planning application for a data centre plus 99MW BESS at the former IBM factory site, Spango Valley, Inverkip Road, Greenock (Inverclyde); public consultation held Mar 2026; two buildings of 34,500 sqm and 40,000 sqm; DC IT capacity not disclosed; PAN submitted to Inverclyde Council.
